page.overview:
Who is Ethrand Tachonis?

is the brother of Occtis Tachonis. As an NPC, he is played by Brennan Lee Mulligan.

Ethrand looks like "the most normal" of the Tachonis. He is somewhat muscular, has black hair swept back and frequently wears a vest with bare arms and a cloak. He is described as "severe, petulant, and angry.".}}

Ethrand was born as one of the younger children of Lord Primus Tachonis. As other members of his lineage, he manifested sorcerous abilities at a very young age, and as of the year 59, when he and his family traveled to the Golden Orchard to attend the trial of Thjazi Fang, he stayed behind to tease his youngest brother, Occtis, for not having magic yet. He even threw a stone at him, but that attracted the attention of two of the local pixies, who scared Ethrand away after one of them assured him she had killed members of his family in the Falconer's Rebellion.

Ethrand was in command of a group of six ghouls who appeared at the Palazzo Davinos during a strike that killed Raimond Davinos, the father of Julien. He appeared at the doorway of the room which Aranessa Royce had given to Occtis Tachonis for the night, casting Silence while holding the Stone of Nightsong. He commanded the ghouls: "Put him on the table, open him up and we'll put the stone where it belongs." During the ensuing battle, Ethrand wielded a knife to slice open the pinioned Occtis, reach into his chest, and replace his beating heart with the Stone of Nightsong, as he declared that his brother had always had something wrong with him, and that he should have embraced the gift of their name. After commanding his ghouls to defenestrate Lady Aranessa (something they failed to do) Ethrand moved away with the heart, and when his father got confirmation that he had it, he Shadow Walked to him and Plane Shifted them both away from the battle between the defenders of House Davinos and the horde of summoned undead. He, however, visited the Palazzo again hours later, when Ophelia Seremai was supervising the preparations to clean the place and make it presentable for the Royce gala.
